column1: # Star names adopted by the IAU Working Group on Star Names (WGSN). build_data.py keeps a proper name from
# d3-celestial only on the star the WGSN gives it to.
# From the IAU Catalog of Star Names on the WGSN's site, https://exopla.net/star-names/modern-iau-star-names/,
# as of 2026-10-16 (its newest names were adopted on 2026-09-22). Mesarthim's HIP number, blank there, is from
# IAU star names are free to use and in the public domain. "-" marks a star with no HIP number.
